turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
Two places carry identifying info right now:

1. **Title page** — has your name and contact block. Strip the whole contact block, leave only the title and "by" line (or just the title, depending on how the contest wants it). Most blind submissions want just the title on the page, no writer credit at all.

2. **Page headers** — every page after the title has your surname in the header. Replace it with just the title (or a shortened version of it) and the page number.

Want me to pull up the screenplay file and the desktop note so I can tell you exactly what's there and what to change?

Got it. Here's what's actually on the draft right now:

**Title page** — "a feature screenplay by User B" plus a bottom-left contact block with your name, email, and phone. Two separate elements in the app.

**Every page header** — "B / KESSLER GIRL / 12" (surname / title / page number). It's a single field in export settings.
